title: Complex bumblebee model
summary: We formulate a renormalizable complex extension of the bumblebee theory in which the bumblebee field is promoted to a complex one and coupled to an Abelian gauge sector. Besides the minimal gauge covariant interaction, the model includes a longitudinal kinetic term controlled by a dimensionless parameter $g_l$ and a non-minimal magnetic-type coupling $g_m$ between the complex bumblebee and the photon.
